text: # Automatic conversation locking Closed issues and pull requests are locked automatically after 30 days of inactivity. ## I want to comment on a locked conversation, what should I do? When an issue has been closed and inactive for over 30 days, the original context is likely outdated. If you encounter a similar or related issue in the current version, please open a new issue and provide up-to-date reproduction instructions. ## Why lock conversations? Automatically locking closed, inactive issues guides people towards filing new issues with updated context rather than commenting on a "resolved" issue that contains out-of-date or unrelated information. As an example, someone may comment "I'm still having this issue", but without providing any of the additional information the team needs to investigate.
